notice.title: Before you start the day: location notice
notice.when: While you are on duty (from Start day until End day), this app records your location: at start, every few minutes, and at each check-in and check-out.
notice.what: It is used only to confirm shop visits and plan routes. It is never recorded off duty.
notice.keep: Location points are deleted after 90 days.
notice.who: Only you, the sales manager and Admin can see them.
notice.ack: I have read the location notice
notice.queued: Start of day saved on this phone · sends when back in signal.
